answer: Creating a sybil identity requires solving a fresh challenge and locking collateral, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts while honest agents recover stakes on attestation. Each agent must stake a bond and complete a unique proof-of-work tied to a randomly assigned terrain token, such as cedar, dune, or canyon, derived from its on-chain history. This makes mass identity forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0190's threat model.
